# CONFORMANCE FIXTURES: refusals that teach (spec 6.3). Every refusal names what to
# write instead; these pin the accept/reject line and the teaching.

== an unknown name
expr flow_rate + 1
error unknown name 'flow_rate'

== an unknown method suggests the neighbour
env note: Text = "x"
expr note.toUpperCase()
error did you mean 'upper'

== a near miss suggests the neighbour
env setpoint: Num = 1
expr setpoint.round(1)
error did you mean 'Round'

== an unknown method on a known shape
env setpoint: Num = 1
expr setpoint.launch()
error has no method 'launch'

== a no-argument method still demands parentheses
env note: Text = "x"
expr note.Length
error is a method

== a method demands parentheses
env note: Text = "x"
expr note.Trim
error is a method

== a transition is not an expression
env value: Num = 1
expr value.smooth(300)
error not written in an expression

== transition by its other name
env value: Num = 1
expr value.transition(300)
error the value stays true

== method arity is checked
env note: Text = "x"
expr note.Slice(1)
error Slice takes 2 arguments

== method argument shapes are checked
env note: Text = "x"
expr note.Slice("a", 2)
error Slice wants Num

== assignment is not an expression
env setpoint: Num = 1
expr setpoint = 1
error unexpected '='

== an unterminated string dies as a non-expression
expr "open
error expected an expression

== an unbalanced parenthesis
expr (1 + 2
error expected ')'

== an empty expression
expr )
error expected an expression

== a dangling operator
expr 1 +
error expected an expression

== a stray token after the expression
expr 1 2
error unexpected '2'

== there is no x in a fixture scope
expr x + 1
error there is no x here

== widget is spelled this now
expr widget.value
error is spelled 'this.value' now

== bare widget teaches the same
expr widget
error 'widget' is spelled 'this' now

== a lambda is legal only under an iterating method
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.Contains(v => v)
error unknown name 'v'

== a bare lambda dies on its name
expr (v => v)
error unknown name 'v'

== the theme token belongs to the template tier
expr $accent + 1
error expected an expression

== keywords do not name methods that do not exist
env on: Bool = true
expr on.and()
error has no method 'and'

== a color literal must parse
expr #ff00zz
error invalid color

== an entity reference outside an entity scope
expr @gauge
error unknown entity '@gauge'

== an entity field outside an entity scope
expr @gauge.value
error unknown field '@gauge.value'
